claims: Jesus lived c. 6–4 BC – AD 30–33.
Jesus was a 1st-century Jewish preacher.
Jesus is the central figure of Christianity.
Christians revere Jesus as the Son of God.
Christians revere Jesus as the Messiah.
Jesus taught love and forgiveness.
Jesus died by crucifixion.
Jesus's life, death by crucifixion, and reported resurrection form the core of Christian faith.
Jesus was born to the Virgin Mary in Bethlehem of Judea.
Jesus's birth is often commemorated at Christmas.
Jesus's ministry began around age 30.
John the Baptist baptized Jesus.
Jesus taught through parables.
Jesus performed miracles.
Jesus's ministry was largely in Galilee and Judea.
Christians believe Jesus is God incarnate (fully divine and fully human).
Christians believe Jesus atoned for human sin through his death and resurrection.
Christians believe Jesus died on the cross.
Christians believe Jesus rose from the dead.
Christians believe Jesus offers eternal life.
Jesus is known as Jesus of Nazareth.
Jesus is known as Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ means "the anointed one".
Jesus is known as the Messiah.
Almost all modern scholars agree that Jesus was a historical figure who lived in the Roman province of Judaea.
Jesus emphasized a personal relationship with God over strict, ritualistic adherence to law.
Jesus stated that the law is fulfilled through love, faith, and the inner state of the heart.
Jesus spent 40 days in the desert.
Jesus chose 12 disciples.
The Last Supper took place.
Jesus was crucified c. AD 30 or 33.
Jesus's resurrection took place.
Jesus's ascension took place.
